params.body:
Follow-up on #120: when nobody points, the round spot of colour wanders slowly over the black-and-white collage (a 28-second keyframe loop on the mask position); a pointer takes it over and leaving hands it back. A phone gets the drift; reduced motion keeps the image grey.

The mask moved from a gradient centred on a variable to a fixed-size mask whose position is animated, which is what makes the idle drift a pure css loop; `hero-reveal.js` now sets the mask corner instead of the centre.

276 tests, Pint, ESLint and the Tailwind lint clean. BRAND.md carries the reason.
params.title: The colour drifts over the collage when nobody points
